name: ironpilot
description: IronPilot - AI gym co-pilot, AI coaching, workout planning and diet guidance

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:memory --prefix server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
